simple.meaning: שָׂמַאל (sâmaʼl) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to use the left hand or pass in that direction.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5 times across Genesis, 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, Isaiah, Ezekiel, beginning at Genesis 13:9. Its contexts include kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׂמַאל (H8041).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שָׂמַאל (sâmaʼl) / H8041 is traced through Genesis 13:9, 2 Samuel 14:19, 1 Chronicles 12:2, Isaiah 30:21 as a generated source-based concept entry.

structuredEvidence.definition: to use the left hand or pass in that direction

firstOccurrence.englishText: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”

timeline.evidenceText: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”
The king said, “Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?”
They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.
and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shook the arrows back and forth. He consulted the teraphim.† teraphim were household idols that may have been associated with inheritance rights to the household property. He looked in the liver.

definitions.short: to use the left hand or pass in that direction
definitions.full: H8041. simel [ שִׂמְאֵל ] verb denominative Hiph`il take the left (always opposed to הֵמִין ): — Imperfect cohortative אַשְׂמְאִ֫ילָה Gen 13:9 ; 2 masculine plural, תַּשְׂמְאִ֫ילוּ Isa 30:21 ; Imperative feminine singular הַשְׂמִילִי (Ges § 23f Kö 1. 276 ) Ezek 21:21 , compare Infinitive construct הַשְׂמִיל 2Sam 14:19 ; Participle מַשְׂמִאלִים 1Chr 12:2 ; — 1 = go to the left Gen 13:9 (J), Ezek 21:21 . 2 figurative turn (aside) to the left (from true way) 2Sam 14:19 ; Isa 30:21 . 3 use the left hand 1Chr 12:2 . [ שָׂמַל ] Hiph`il see [ שַׂמְאַל ]
